rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the granddaughter's parent is unspecified or the family relationship is clear from context.

example.english: My granddaughter is in primary school this year.
example.traditional: 我個孫女今年讀緊小學喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 syun1 neoi5 gam1 nin4 duk6 gan2 siu2 hok6 laa3

rows.note: Use this when the granddaughter is specifically your daughter's daughter.

example.english: My daughter often brings my granddaughter over to play.
example.traditional: 我個女成日帶個外孫女返嚟玩。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 neoi5 seng4 jat6 daai3 go3 ngoi6 syun1 neoi5 faan1 lei4 waan2

rows.note: Use this when the granddaughter is specifically your son's daughter and that lineage distinction matters.

example.english: My son’s daughter is due soon; she’ll be my first granddaughter.
example.traditional: 我個仔個女就快出世喇，係我第一個內孫女。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 zai2 go3 neoi5 zau6 faai3 ceot1 sai3 laa3 hai6 ngo5 dai6 jat1 go3 noi6 syun1 neoi5
